title: Taking turns
examples: What do I do if my friend keeps playing with my toy?
How can I remember to wait my turn?
Can we use a clock to help us take turns?

explain.say: Sometimes we want to play with a toy right away. It feels exciting to play with it now.
When someone else is playing, we must wait for our turn. Waiting helps us be patient friends.
Sharing means letting others use your toys too. We can take turns with all our things.
We can use a timer to help us know when it is our turn. The timer tells us when to stop.
When you and your friend play with the red crayons, you must wait for your turn. Taking turns means you get to use the crayons after your friend is finished. This keeps playtime fun for everyone.

faq.q: What if I really want to play with a toy right now?
faq.a: It is okay to want things right away. You can take a big breath and remember to wait for your turn.
asks: What should I do when I want a toy?
How do I wait my turn?

faq.a: Yes, sharing is fun because it lets everyone play together. It makes playing with friends much better.
asks: Do I have to share everything?

faq.q: Why do we need a timer for playing?
faq.a: A timer helps us know when our turn is finished. It makes sure everyone gets a chance to play.
asks: How does a timer help us?
Can a clock help us take turns?

faq.q: What if my friend does not want to share?
faq.a: You can use your words to ask nicely for a turn. You can also ask a grown-up for help.
asks: What if my friend is selfish?

faq.q: Does waiting make me feel grumpy?
faq.a: Sometimes waiting feels hard. You can try counting slowly to help your body feel calm.
asks: How do I feel when I wait?

facts: Taking turns means letting others use things too.
Waiting helps us practice being patient friends.
A timer can help us keep track of playtime.
Sharing toys makes playing more fun for everyone.

quiz.say: You and a friend are coloring. You finish your picture and want the red crayon. Your friend is using it. What is the best thing to do?

options.show: Walk away and play with something else.
options.say: Walk away and play with something else.

options.show: Wait until the timer goes off.
options.say: Wait until the timer goes off.

options.show: Take the crayon when they look away.
options.say: Take the crayon when they look away.

quiz.why: Using your words is the best way to ask for something you want.

wrong.0: This is tempting because it stops the problem, but you should try to talk about it.
wrong.2: This is tempting because it is fair, but you should ask first.
wrong.3: This is tempting because it is quick, but it is not sharing.

quiz.say: A game lasts for five minutes. If you take turns, and you play for two minutes, how much time is left for your friend?
quiz.why: If five minutes minus two minutes equals three minutes, that is the time left.

wrong.0: This is tempting because you are guessing the middle amount.
wrong.1: This is tempting because you are remembering the total time.
wrong.3: This is tempting because you are adding the times together.
